parsing_traps: Gross revenue != GRI (trap #4): CICT defines Gross revenue = GRI + car park income + other income (Note 21, p159: GRI 1,514,171k + car park 40,243k + other 64,760k = 1,619,174k). Per-property 'Gross Revenue' figures throughout are on this GR definition.

Combined 'Other Assets' line (trap #10): Financial Review per-property GR merges Bugis+ and Bukit Panjang Plaza into one 'Other Assets' line = 65.7m (p25 footnote 1); both factsheets repeat this combined 65.7m / 99.9% occupancy. Recorded the combined GR + occupancy on Bugis+ only; Bukit Panjang Plaza GR/occupancy set null to prevent double-counting in reconciliation.

ION Orchard equity-accounted JV (trap #9): CICT owns 50% of ION Orchard; it is NOT in the audited Portfolio Statement and is excluded from the consolidated GR/NPI total. Captured as a separate property row (value_basis=joint_venture_100pct) but EXCLUDED from the Sigma-property reconciliation.

CapitaSpring dual-basis GR (trap #7): Financial Review GR 37.7m is the consolidated period 26 Aug-31 Dec 2025 (post-acquisition of balance 55%) and is the figure that reconciles to the 1,619.2 total; the factsheet prints full-year 100%-basis 72.7m. Stored 37.7m as gross_revenue, 72.7m as alt_value_gross_revenue.

Distributable-income layering (trap #12): headline 860.9m (p26) != distribution-statement subtotal 869.957m != amount available for distribution 1,119.753m (incl. 249.796m opening balance). Took the 860.9m headline for net_distributable_income.

Dual valuation source/currency for overseas assets (trap #7/#19): Gallileo, MAC, 66 Goulburn, 100 Arthur, Miller St print local-currency appraisals (EUR/AUD) on factsheets and SGD carrying values in the audited Portfolio Statement. Audited SGD figure wins market_valuation; local-currency appraisal -> alt_value. NB 66 Goulburn's factsheet S$ conversion (202.8m) differs from its audited PS figure (223.7m) - audited PS used.

Land-lease start dates embedded in prose (trap #3): factsheet 'Land Tenure' strings carry 'X years with effect from DATE' - parsed into effective_date + lease_term_years; lease_expiry_date computed as effective_date + term. IMM Building factsheet says '30 + 30 years' (renewal structure) but audited PS Term of Lease = 60 years -> lease_term_years=60.

66 Goulburn Street partial tenure (trap #20): factsheet gives only 'Leasehold expiring 16 August 2116' (no start date); lease_expiry_date filled from the verbatim string, effective_date/lease_term_years null.

Number of unitholders not printed as a single figure: derived by summing the 5 size-bands on the Statistics of Unitholdings distribution table (7,631+28,037+40,910+14,795+48 = 91,421), as at 27 Feb 2026 (p193).
